title: Put susi on PATH automatically, with one consent
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. After install, add the bin dir to the shell rc for the detected shell (bash, zsh, fish) idempotently, asking once. Check script runs against fake rc files.
